purpose: Input readiness for software detailed design — implementation patterns and per-feature design before detail-design generation.

standards.scope: Software detailed design process (§6.5.4) — units refinable to code, internal/external interfaces

standards.title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022
standards.scope: Architecture decisions and rationale documented for implementation stakeholders

standards.title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15289:2019
standards.scope: Design description (§10.15) — sufficient detail to permit coding and testing

standards.title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018
standards.scope: Bidirectional traceability from requirements through BD to DD (§5.2.8)

standards.title: IEEE Std 1016-2009

standards.title: ISO/IEC 25010:2011
standards.scope: Quality attributes implemented in common patterns and per-feature design

individualCharacteristics.name: Allocable to code
individualCharacteristics.check: Design is refined to units that can be coded, compiled, and tested without further design decisions

individualCharacteristics.name: Interface complete
individualCharacteristics.check: Internal and external interfaces documented sufficiently to implement without guessing

individualCharacteristics.name: Traceable
individualCharacteristics.check: Each feature design references SRS requirements and BD API/screen specs — no orphan implementation

individualCharacteristics.name: Pattern-consistent
individualCharacteristics.check: Feature implementations follow common chapters (security, errors, performance) unless deviation is justified

individualCharacteristics.name: Verifiable
individualCharacteristics.check: Sequences, components, and data flows are specific enough to derive test cases

dimensions.label: Cross-cutting patterns
dimensions.description: Security, error handling, performance, integration, deployment

dimensions.label: SRS → BD → DD traceability
dimensions.description: Feature inventory and per-feature links to requirements and BD specs

dimensions.label: Per-feature detailed design
dimensions.description: Sequences, components, data flow, implementation approach per F-xx

globalCriteria.question: Confirm basic design (DB, API list/detail, screen list/detail) is complete enough to drive detailed design?
Confirm implementation technology stack and major runtime components for this project.
Rank quality priorities for implementation (security vs performance vs maintainability) when patterns conflict.

criteria.question: Confirm the system architecture stack and major components for detail design.
Confirm module/layer boundaries and dependency direction (e.g. API → service → repository).
Confirm authentication, authorization, and data protection patterns to apply across features.
Confirm error handling strategy (API errors, retries, user messaging).
Confirm performance targets and measurement approach for feature implementations.
Confirm external systems and integration patterns (sync/async, messaging).
Confirm deployment topology and infrastructure constraints.
Confirm the complete feature inventory (F-xx ids + titles) matches the traceability graph.
For each feature, confirm implementation approach and which basic-design API/screen docs apply.
For each feature, confirm sequence diagrams and component breakdown are derivable from UC flows and BD APIs.
